decisions: Backend-originated messages are localized by backend code.
Scope includes CLI, API, and MCP user/agent-facing messages.
English is the only runtime locale in this phase.
Code remains the source of emitted IDs.
The message registry must contain real i18n.Message literals for goi18n extract.
active.en.toml is generated/checked from Go source and embedded at runtime.
Existing message, template, args, code, and messageId compatibility fields remain.
Existing positional args are bridged to Arg0/Arg1 template data.
Frontend API error rendering trusts backend-rendered message.
Shell wrapper messages use generated English shell catalog data from the Go registry.
Semantic hygiene and catalog coverage are enforced.
Behavior tests assert IDs/codes/semantic attrs/typed IDs, not prose, except explicit allowed cases.
